correctness.rationale: For each irrational sigma>1, floor-counting exact crossing times gives normalized event density alpha=1/(1+sigma) and c_j=floor((j+2)alpha)-floor((j+1)alpha). Phases on the two sides of theta=alpha give both predecessor digits while leaving any finite future prefix unchanged. Irrational rotation density makes these real factors; reflection rho(theta)=1-alpha-theta gives reversal closure. Binary Sturmian p(m)=m+1 forces one reversed characteristic-prefix right-special factor, and splitting rotor word by parity lifts the unique two extensions through symbol 2; the initial 0 and n=1 are handled. The proof works for all lengths without computation. verify.py independently checks exact integer crossing order and right-extensions for seven quadratic slopes through n=80 (24080 assertions).
